# Provider factory dispatch and graceful error on unknown providers

A factory builds LLM providers and raises a clear LLMProviderError for unknown providers. Paths for major providers (anthropic/openai) are expected to raise a controlled LLMProviderError when SDKs or credentials are absent, enabling degraded operation rather than raw crashes.
